binding_policy: Literal definition names have spaces, not Ghidra symbol underscores. Static adapter looks up those exact model nodes, then each button's numbered normal00..normal08 and actived00..actived08 visuals beneath its container. The parent/child relationship and visual vtable are checked at runtime, not inferred from screen coordinates.
layout_correction: 2026-10-27: cached exports and section-mapped original assembly establish omitted horizontal padding: trunc(width * inset / 1024), with inset 10 for type-14 buttons and 1 for type-13 static text. At 800 pixels this moves button captions right by 7 pixels and reduces their text rectangle by 14 pixels; static-text rectangles are unchanged. Keep raw visual rectangles for host Exit hover/click. Fonts, glyph sizing, vertical placement and artwork are unchanged. A real-asset geometry audit checks all 13 labels against the text rectangles; it is not rendering proof.
render_state_policy: New adapter snapshots and restores every D3D render/texture-stage state it changes, stage-zero texture and pixel shader, and restores viewport through IGraph. Device access is a borrowed, fingerprint/relocation-guarded field bridge, not a recovered font API. Do not apply an all-state block: restoring vertex format behind IGraph's FVF cache would desynchronize it.
interaction_policy: Only Exit is enabled; unsupported button captions use the original disabled alpha 0x60. UI mode initializes all nine pairs as normal visible/actived hidden. Original conditional local-position alignment at frame+b0 and dirty flags at +e0 are reproduced before updating the active visual. Exit hover switches original normal07/actived07 visibility and uses white focused-text color; cursor absence/focus loss restores normal. One hover sample drives scene and caption in the same frame. Win32 press/release inside the unchanged normal07 rectangle closes this host. This is a host-owned focus adapter, not the original dispatcher, UI sound events, confirmation flow or other screens. Artwork-only mode does not initialize or switch pairs.
asset_policy: Read original loose English TEXTY and ANSI Set2 atlases/metrics locally. Stage a provenance-tracked five-asset slice, including a newly defined H2MT label bundle. No game text or atlas is redistributed. Fixed 800x600; dynamic profile/date/save/version values remain absent.
research_outputs: analysis/work/menu-label-layout (four successful exports; later non-entry request rejected), menu-label-alignment (three), menu-label-final (three), menu-overlay-states (two), menu-overlay-graphics (one format-name query, not a state API). All ignored.
verification_boundary: User desktop observations and direct host logs confirm bounded static text/Exit, corrected horizontal inset, visual selection, rectangle-driven confirmation interaction, opt-in engine-picking interaction with motion events, button click-event ordering, focused-screen clicks, Escape and left-button input-probe samples. Right-button and double-click probe cases, pixel-perfect blending, exhaustive hover/cancellation edge cases and complete original UI dispatch are not established.
